name: Zul'Farrak
_terrain: Turtle's additions to the 3.3.5 dungeon: the Farraki Arena (a basin cut into the hill west of the pyramid, its own building tanarisruins16.wmo; Champion Razjal the Quick, Kath'zen the Brutal, Juthza the Cunning) and Zel'jeb the Ancient's ritual cave under the northern cliffs (tanarisruins17.wmo, entered through a new opening in the ground; Zel'jeb and eleven Sandfury Ritualists), plus two Ancient Burial Containers (Hansu Go'sha's 'Drifting Across the Sand', Tanaris) and the Flame of Farrak. Everything else stays 3.3.5.
_merge_region: Only the chunks Turtle changed: the arena basin (TanarisInstance_29_29 and 30_29), the ground around the cave's building and its new entrance hole (29_28; take_hole_changes also takes a chunk whose only change is a hole). Turtle's server maps show the same ground everywhere else (within 0.3 yd). drop_removed_wmos: Turtle's arena building (tanarisruins16) and cave (tanarisruins17) are reworked copies of 3.3.5's TanarisRuins07 and 09, placed at the same spots; the 3.3.5 originals go (on all four tiles that place them). ship_replaced_wmo_tiles: TanarisInstance_30_28 has no changed ground but places the arena building too, so it is shipped with the new building.
_all_spawns: Zul'Farrak has no world-map rectangle (a vanilla dungeon): every Turtle spawn on map 209 of a template 3.3.5 does not have is this zone's (Turtle's spawns of 3.3.5 templates are not added).
_exclude_gameobjects: A second Gong of Zul'Farrak (Turtle id 20901, never spawned: spawntime -1) on the spot of 3.3.5's gong 141832.
_extra_creature_templates: Sandfury Scorpid: Champion Razjal summons ten during the arena fight.
